text: At its October 5, 2018 meeting, the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Grants and Programs Committee recommended that the Board approve eight grants with a combined value of $544,801, and one project allocation with a value of $183,500.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the following grant requests funded jointly from the Ontario and City of Toronto endowments except where otherwise indicated: a. $189,500 over two years to the Hamilton Chamber of Commerce to accelerate the adoption of waste heat to energy applications in Hamilton's Industrial sector, a major step in driving energy conservation, lowering carbon emissions and promoting business competitiveness (funded from the Ontario endowment only); b. $103,632 over one year to the Ontario Public Health Association to build awareness and support for climate action among Ontario's health professionals and Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA) suburban parents by delivering a communications initiative focused on the critical links between climate change and health. c. $70,000 over two years to the Toronto and Region Conservation…
